title: The Moss Pillow on the North Stone
youtube_title: The Moss Pillow on the North Stone | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Showing someone how to look is a kind of gift.
summary: At a meadow fence and a bucket of water, Pilar finds a moss pillow on the stone that never got noon. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Pilar shows Tala how to look without disturbing it. Auntie Luz looks too, and they leave it where it is.
